newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE temporarily withdraws March and May 1998 oats.
newsitem.headline: WCE temporarily withdraws March and May 1998 oats.

text.p: March 1998 and May 1998 oats futures contracts were temporarily withdrawn from the Winnipeg Commodity Exchange on Thursday, a WCE statement to members posted on the WCE trading floor said.
The WCE's board of governors at Wednesday evening's meeting approved amendments to shipping logistics in the oats futures contract specifications, the statement said.
WCE president Ben Corn was not immediately available for comment.
The March and May 1998 contracts will be relisted on the WCE on Wednesday, July 2, 1997, the statement said.
